Yes. You can export your data whenever you want, and it's part of the free plan, so there's nothing to upgrade.

There are two formats: CSV and JSON. Pick CSV if you want to open your transactions in Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers to sort, filter or do your own analysis. JSON is better if you're a developer or you're moving your data into another app or tool that takes structured data.

It doesn't take long. A history of 10,000 transactions exports in under two minutes, and smaller accounts are usually done in a few seconds. You can keep using the app while it runs.

To export, open your account settings and find the data or export section. Choose CSV or JSON, confirm, and save the file to your device once it's ready.

It's your data, so export it as often as you like. You might want a backup, want to look at your spending in another tool, or be switching to a different service. There's no limit on exports and no extra fee.
